visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a white t-shirt and grey shorts, leans over a black vanity drawer in a modern dressing room. (2) He stands upright in front of a large rectangular mirror with perimeter lighting, gesturing with his hands towards the vanity surface which holds various makeup brushes and cosmetic bottles. (3) The man opens a wide drawer beneath the counter, revealing a densely packed and organized collection of palettes and makeup tubes. (4) He moves to a tall black cabinet on the right and pulls open a sliding vertical drawer system that houses dozens of high-end skincare products. (5) He pulls out specific dark blue and gold bottles from the shelves, holding them close to the camera for inspection. (6) He holds up a large green tub of cream, opening the lid to display the white thick texture inside. (7) He moves to the adjacent cabinet section which is filled with hair sprays, a hair dryer, and various grooming accessories. (8) He stands in the center of the small room, extending his arms to showcase the space, and finally brings his hands together in a thankful gesture.

The acoustics capture the sound of dozens of glass bottles rattling slightly against the metal shelf. (4) Rapid 'pop' and 'ping' sound effects occur every time a specific brand name is mentioned or a product is pointed to. BGM remains at a steady, high-energy level with a dominant synth bass.
